_comment: EXAMPLE OBC-side rate-group LUT change file (NO command id — the OBC does not store ids to save memory). To change the polled set: copy config/rate_group_lut.json, edit the 'commands' array (reorder/remove rows or change resp_size), BUMP 'revision', then uplink it from the GS with the [u] menu. Rows are matched to the GS-side labels purely by 'order'. Each row must be self-contained: 'tc_hex' is the exact native TC bytes (regenerate with xdos_gen_rate_lut if you change WHICH command — only the ground can build TC bytes from the Database). Keep the matching config/rate_group_lut_gs.json (with ids + response names) on the ground for decoding; the shared 'signature' keeps the two in lockstep.
